description: Performance audit documentation, database query optimization (select_related/prefetch_related/only/annotate), and additional database indexes. Covers all high-traffic apps: orders, billing, payments, menu, inventory, kitchen, notifications, reporting, central_control, enterprise, accounts. Also sets CONN_MAX_AGE in settings.py and creates all five docs/ files.
steps: 1. Create docs/performance_assessment_phase22.md at the repo root (not inside backend/). Document: (a) N+1 patterns found — OrderListCreateView fetches items without branch select_related; BillListView fetches order without select_related; KitchenConsumer _get_current_state already has select_related but initial list views do not; reporting services already use DB aggregation. (b) Missing indexes: notifications.Notification has no index on source_type/source_id; enterprise.EnterpriseConfiguration has no index on effective_from/effective_to; crm.Customer has no composite index on restaurant+is_active. (c) Existing cache usage: reporting/services.py uses django.core.cache for sales_trend, top_items, branch, financial; no cache on menu catalog, dashboard KPIs, or notifications list. (d) Pagination: global PAGE_SIZE=20 set, but several list views do not enforce a MAX page size cap. (e) WebSocket: KitchenConsumer group=kitchen_{branch_id} (branch-scoped, correct); CentralControlConsumer group=company_{org_id}_central_control (org-scoped, correct); NotificationsConsumer group=notifications_user_{user_id} (user-scoped, correct). (f) Celery: three task files found (notifications, crm, marketing); no queue routing configured — all use default queue. (g) Frontend: no React.lazy/Suspense; App.tsx imports ~50 page components eagerly at the top level, increasing initial JS parse time. Mark all metrics not measurable without a running environment as UNAVAILABLE.

2. Add select_related() and prefetch_related() to fix N+1 patterns in views. Changes: (a) backend/orders/views.py — OrderListCreateView.get_queryset: add .select_related('branch', 'created_by', 'assigned_waiter', 'table', 'counter') before .prefetch_related('items'). OrderDetailView.get_queryset: add .select_related('branch', 'created_by', 'assigned_waiter', 'table', 'counter') before .prefetch_related('items__menu_item'). TableSessionListView.get_queryset: add .select_related('table__branch', 'opened_by'). (b) backend/billing/views.py — BillListView (wherever it lists bills): add .select_related('branch', 'order', 'created_by', 'finalized_by'). BillDetailView: add .prefetch_related('items__menu_item', 'items__order_item'). (c) backend/payments/views.py — PaymentListView: add .select_related('bill__order__branch', 'initiated_by', 'counter'). (d) backend/kitchen/views.py (if exists) or any kitchen list view: ensure KitchenOrder list uses .select_related('order__branch', 'order__table', 'order__counter').prefetch_related('items__menu_item'). (e) backend/inventory/views.py — StockBalance list: add .select_related('inventory_item__restaurant', 'storage_location__branch'). PurchaseOrder list: add .select_related('supplier', 'branch', 'restaurant', 'created_by'). StockMovement list: add .select_related('inventory_item', 'storage_location', 'performed_by'). (f) backend/notifications/views.py — Notification list: add .select_related('company', 'restaurant', 'branch'). NotificationRecipient list: add .select_related('notification', 'user'). (g) backend/enterprise/views.py — EnterpriseConfiguration list: add .select_related('company', 'restaurant', 'branch'). StaffTransfer list: add .select_related('from_branch', 'to_branch', 'requested_by', 'approved_by'). (h) backend/reporting/dashboard_services.py — verify get_dashboard_kpis uses aggregate() not Python loops. If it iterates querysets to sum, rewrite to use django.db.models.Sum/Count/Coalesce in a single .aggregate() call per entity.

3. Add missing database indexes. Read each app's latest migration first to avoid duplicates. Add new migration files using SeparateDatabaseAndState or RunSQL with 'CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY' for tables likely to be large at deploy time (orders_order, billing_bill, payments_payment, inventory_stockmovement, notifications_notification). Files to create: (a) backend/notifications/migrations/0002_performance_indexes.py — depends on 0001_initial. Add indexes on Notification: (company, notification_type, created_at), (source_type, source_id), (restaurant, status, created_at), (branch, status, created_at). Add indexes on NotificationRecipient: (user, is_read, created_at), (notification, user). (b) backend/enterprise/migrations/0002_performance_indexes.py — depends on 0001_initial. Add indexes on EnterpriseConfiguration: (company, key, effective_from), (branch, key, is_active). Add on StaffBranchAssignment: (user, branch, is_active). Add on MenuRollout: (company, status, created_at). (c) backend/crm/migrations/0002_performance_indexes.py — depends on 0001_initial. Add indexes on Customer: (restaurant, is_active, created_at), (email) where email is not already indexed. Add on LoyaltyAccount: (loyalty_program, points_balance). (d) backend/marketing/migrations/0002_performance_indexes.py — depends on 0001_initial. Add indexes on Campaign: (restaurant, status, start_date), (restaurant, status, end_date). (e) backend/menu/migrations/0002_performance_indexes.py — depends on 0001_initial. Add indexes on MenuItemPrice: (menu_item, branch, effective_from), (menu_item, branch, is_active). Add on MenuItemBranch: (branch, is_available), (menu_item, branch). Use RunSQL with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY inside SeparateDatabaseAndState for the orders_order and billing_bill tables (already have many indexes — only add if truly missing after reading 0001_initial). Do NOT duplicate any index already declared in model Meta.indexes.

4. Add CONN_MAX_AGE to backend/config/settings.py DATABASES config. Set CONN_MAX_AGE=60 (seconds), appropriate for Gunicorn with sync workers. Add comment referencing PgBouncer as optional external pooler. Also add CELERY_TASK_ROUTES to config/settings.py to route tasks to named queues: notifications.* -> notifications queue; crm.* -> maintenance queue; marketing.* -> maintenance queue; reports.* -> reports queue; default for all others. Create docs/scalability_guide.md documenting CONN_MAX_AGE rationale, PgBouncer optional setup (external process, transaction pooling mode), Celery queue configuration, and guidance on horizontal scaling (Gunicorn workers, Celery worker concurrency per queue).

5. Create docs/database_optimization.md documenting: indexes added in this phase with the query pattern each index supports; select_related/prefetch_related changes made and what N+1 they eliminate; CONN_MAX_AGE rationale; guidelines for future query review (use django-debug-toolbar in development, EXPLAIN ANALYZE in staging).
acceptance_criteria: python manage.py check returns zero errors
python manage.py makemigrations --check shows no pending migrations (all new migrations committed)
python manage.py test passes all existing tests
docs/performance_assessment_phase22.md exists and contains sections for each audit area
CELERY_TASK_ROUTES defined in settings.py with at minimum notifications, maintenance, reports queues
No duplicate indexes (verified by reading existing model Meta.indexes before adding new migration)
